title: Alistigo CALM node-type extension
description: Alistigo's own extension to FINOS CALM v1.2. Defines the alistigo-specific node-type values and the metadata conventions that apply to each type. CALM's node-type field accepts any string; this schema gives precise semantics and documents expected metadata within the alistigo context.

ddd-layer.title: ddd-layer
ddd-layer.description: The DDD architectural layer this node belongs to. Used as a metadata field on module and system nodes.

module.title: module
module.description: A cohesive unit of functionality with a clearly defined boundary and at least one public interface. Implemented by one or more npm packages. A module enforces encapsulation: consumers interact only through its declared interfaces. Examples: domain, document, ui, storage, logger.

core-npm-package.description: The primary npm package that implements this module (e.g. @alistigo/core-document). Required on all module nodes except the Domain module, which is a pure DDD domain with no framework dependency and therefore has no implementation package of its own.

ddd-layer.description: Required on all module nodes. Identifies where in the DDD layering this module sits.

skill.title: skill
skill.description: An AI agent capability definition node. A skill has no runtime code dependencies — it is a documentation and metadata asset (SKILL.md + optional JSON schema) that describes how an AI agent should generate, configure, and interact with an artifact. Published as an npm package and loaded on demand by AI chat interfaces and agent runtimes. No ddd-layer or core-npm-package fields apply to this node type.

system.title: system
system.description: A deployable or composable system that wires together multiple modules. In alistigo's context this is typically the Artifact node — the composition root that assembles domain, document, UI, storage, and logger modules and injects plugins at startup.

core-npm-package.description: Optional. The primary npm package that implements this system (e.g. @alistigo/artifact-core).

ddd-layer.description: Optional. The DDD layer this system primarily belongs to.
